title: WaxalNet: Benchmarking and Adapting Speech Recognition for Spontaneous Speech in 19 African Languages
abstract: arXiv:2606.02375v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multilingual speech foundation models claim broad language coverage, but how well they handle spontaneous African speech, and how best to adapt them, remains unclear. We benchmark zero-shot and fine-tuned speech recognition on the WAXAL corpus of spontaneous speech in 19 African languages, covering Whisper, MMS, Omnilingual ASR, and SeamlessM4T-v2. Fine-tuning lowers macro word error rate (WER) from 52.3 for the best zero-shot model covering all 19 languages (Omnilingual-7B) to 36.2 for a 300M-parameter MMS model and 31.5 for Omnilingual with an LLM decoder, although zero-shot models are already competitive on a few languages. Using Omnilingual's shared encoder, we compare CTC and LLM decoders with encoder pretraining held fixed. translated_title: WaxalNet：面向19种非洲语言自发语音的语音识别基准测试与适配
translated_abstract: 多语言语音基础模型声称具有广泛的语言覆盖能力，但它们对非洲自发语音的处理效果如何，以及如何最好地进行适配，目前仍不明确。我们在包含19种非洲语言自发语音的WAXAL语料库上，对零样本和微调后的语音识别进行了基准测试，所评测的模型涵盖Whisper、MMS、Omnilingual ASR和SeamlessM4T-v2。微调将覆盖所有19种语言的最佳零样本模型（Omnilingual-7B）的宏观词错误率（WER）从52.3降低至36.2（300M参数的MMS模型）和31.5（配备LLM解码器的Omnilingual模型），不过零样本模型在少数语言上已具备竞争力。利用Omnilingual的共享编码器，我们在固定编码器预训练的条件下比较了CTC解码器与LLM解码器。在MMS与Whisper之间，哪个模型更优取决于具体语系，但在共享编码器的条件下，LLM解码器在19种语言中的18种上取得了更低的WER，因此这种语系间的性能差异更可能来源于预训练……
tldr: 该研究构建了覆盖19种非洲语言自发语音的基准测试，发现微调可将最佳零样本模型的词错误率从52.3大幅降至31.5，且在共享编码器条件下LLM解码器在18/19种语言上优于CTC解码器，表明不同模型家族的性能差异更可能源自预训练而非解码器架构。
en_tdlr: This work benchmarks speech recognition on spontaneous speech across 19 African languages, showing fine-tuning cuts macro WER from 52.3 to 31.5, and that with a shared encoder an LLM decoder outperforms CTC on 18 of 19 languages, suggesting language-family performance gaps stem from pretraining rather than decoder architecture.
